name: smtpConnectionTest
syntax: smtpConnectionTest(host [, port] [, username] [, password] [, useTls] [, useSsl] [, timeout])
description: Opens a connection to an SMTP server to verify reachability and (optionally) credentials, the same way cfmail does. Uses the same TLS ladder as cfmail: implicit TLS (useSsl), else STARTTLS (useTls, the default), else plaintext; a requested-but-unavailable TLS is a failure, never a silent downgrade. Returns a struct with success (boolean), authFailed (true when the server rejected the credentials, SMTP 534/535/538) and message (a human-readable detail, empty on success).

params.name: username
params.description: Optional SMTP username; when present the password is used and auth is tested.

params.name: useSsl
params.description: Use implicit TLS (default false); takes precedence over useTls.

examples.title: Test a relay
examples.description: Check that an SMTP relay is reachable on port 587.

examples.title: Test credentials
examples.description: A wrong password reports authFailed = true.
